title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**Graystone Capital \| Dubai \- UAE** 




**www.graystone\-capital.com** 





**Fluency in English is a Must.** 




  





**About us** 




 Graystone Capital arranges and structures debt financing for businesses across the GCC and wider region. We work with clients on trade finance, working capital, and structured credit, connecting them to the right funding partners.
 



  





**The role** 




 We're looking for an HR Generalist to own the people function end to end. This is a hands\-on role in a lean team, you won't be handing work off to a department, you'll be doing it, from drafting an offer letter in the morning to sitting in on a difficult conversation in the afternoon.
 



  





 You'll be the person who makes sure the firm is compliant, that people are paid correctly and on time, and that someone joining us from outside the UAE has a visa, a bank account, and a desk on day one. Discretion is non\-negotiable.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run the full employee lifecycle, offers, contracts, onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, and final settlements
* Manage visa, work permit, Emirates ID, and medical processes end to end, coordinating with PROs and government portals
* Prepare and maintain employment contracts and ensure they reflect current UAE labour law and internal policy
* Own monthly payroll input and WPS submission, including allowances, deductions, leave, and end\-of\-service calculations
* Administer medical insurance, renewals, additions, and claims support
* Coordinate recruitment, job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, references, and offer negotiation support
* Maintain accurate personnel files, leave records, and HR documentation with absolute confidentiality
* Advise managers on disciplinary matters, grievances, probation reviews, and performance issues
* Run the performance review cycle and keep KPI documentation current across the team
* Draft and update HR policies, the employee handbook, and internal communications
* Track compliance deadlines — visa expiries, passport validity, insurance renewals, labour card renewals
* Support leadership with headcount planning, cost reporting, and HR data on request



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Three or more years in a generalist HR role in the UAE, covering both operations and employee relations
* Working knowledge of UAE Federal Decree\-Law No. 33 of 2021, MOHRE procedures, and WPS requirements
* Hands\-on experience with visa and immigration processes — MOHRE, GDRFA, and free zone portals
* Strong drafting ability in English; able to write contracts, policies, and sensitive correspondence without supervision
* Sound judgement with confidential and commercially sensitive information
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word; experience with an HRIS an advantage
* Organised and self\-directed — comfortable being the only HR person in the room
* Calm and even\-handed in difficult conversations
* Experience in financial services, banking, or professional services an advantage
* Bachelor's degree in HR, business, or a related field
* CIPD or SHRM certification an advantage
* Arabic an advantage for government and PRO liaison



  





**Why join us** 




 You'll own the HR function rather than inherit a slice of it, and you'll work directly with leadership on decisions that shape how the firm grows. We're a lean team, so what you build here will be the way things are done.
 



  





**Industry** 



* Financial Services



  





**Employment Type** 




 Full\-time

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
Business Intelligence
 



  





**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 This is the
 **control tower for the business** 
 .
 



  





 Beyond building dashboards, you’ll have a pulse on the key business levers —
 **AOP, P\&L, costs, channel performance, people plans and functional metrics** 
 — and ensure nothing material escapes management’s attention.
 



  





 The role sits at the intersection of
 **data, business and decision\-making** 
 , turning numbers into clear insights, early warnings and actions for leadership.
 



  





 What You’ll Own
 



  





**Dashboards \& Business Reporting** 




  




* Build and own management dashboards across HR, SCM, Finance, GT, MT and other key functions.
* Standardise reporting formats and data definitions in partnership with function heads.
* Consolidate and present weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews to leadership.



  





**AOP \& P\&L Control** 




  




* Maintain close oversight of
 **AOP vs. actuals** 
 across functions.
* Track key cost headers, identify variances and proactively flag deviations.
* Drive the monthly and quarterly
 **P\&L reconciliation cadence** 
 against plan.



  





**Business Lever Monitoring** 




  




* Maintain a live view of critical business levers — channel and category performance, cost efficiency, hiring and people\-plan progress, and other key metrics.
* Identify risks, gaps and opportunities before they become business issues.
* Act as an
 **early\-warning system for management** 
 , ensuring critical deviations get visibility and action.
* Support scenario planning and what\-if analysis for key business decisions.



  





**Analytics \& Systems** 



* Own the analytics and reporting toolkit required for near\-real\-time business visibility.
* Evaluate and drive tooling and system improvements that make data more accessible, accurate and actionable.
* Improve data quality, reporting efficiency and automation across functions.



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  




* Experience in
 **Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, FP\&A, Management Reporting or Business Finance** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **AOP, P\&L, variance analysis and business performance metrics** 
 .
* Ability to work across multiple functions and understand how different business levers connect.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and translating numbers into clear business insights.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Someone who is
 **proactive, commercially minded and naturally curious about how the business works** 
 .
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and BI/visualisation tools; experience with automation and data systems is a plus.



  





 Why This Role?
 



  





 You won’t just report what happened.
 



  





 You’ll help leadership understand
 **what’s happening, why it’s happening and what needs attention next.**

title: Training and Placement Officer
description:
**Training \& Placement Officer** 




**Organization:** 
 Kingston Educational Institute (KEI)
 



**Department:** 
 Training \& Placement
 



**Location:** 
 Barasat / Madhyamgram, West Bengal
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-7 Years
 



**Salary:** 
 28,000/\- to 35,000/\-
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head / Senior Officer – Training \& Placement
 



**About the Role** 




 Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is seeking a dynamic, proactive, and result\-oriented
 **Training \& Placement Officer** 
 to support and strengthen the activities of the Training \& Placement and Corporate Relations Cell.
 



 The incumbent will be responsible for coordinating student training programs, internships, campus recruitment drives, employer interactions, career development initiatives, and placement\-related activities across various academic departments. The role requires strong communication, coordination, networking, documentation, and follow\-up skills, along with the ability to work closely with students, faculty members, management, and corporate recruiters.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Training \& Student Development** 



* Coordinate and support training programs designed to improve students' employability and industry readiness.
* Organize aptitude training, soft\-skills training, communication skills, interview preparation, group discussions, and other career development programs.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, guest lectures, industry sessions, career counselling programs, and pre\-placement talks.
* Identify students' training requirements in coordination with academic departments.
* Maintain records of student participation, attendance, performance, and training outcomes.



**2\. Placement \& Recruitment Coordination** 



* Coordinate campus recruitment drives from initial communication with recruiters through completion of the recruitment process.
* Assist in identifying and inviting companies for campus placement and internship opportunities.
* Coordinate student registration, eligibility verification, shortlisting, and communication with candidates.
* Schedule aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds, HR interviews, and other recruitment activities.
* Ensure timely communication of recruitment schedules, instructions, and requirements to students and concerned departments.
* Support recruiters during campus visits and ensure smooth execution of placement activities.



**3\. Corporate \& Employer Relations** 



* Develop and maintain professional relationships with HR professionals, recruiters, corporate organizations, and industry representatives.
* Assist in identifying new companies and industry partners for placements, internships, training, and institutional collaborations.
* Maintain an updated database of recruiters, corporate contacts, placement partners, and industry organizations.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with recruiters regarding placement opportunities and recruitment requirements.
* Assist in coordinating corporate meetings, industry visits, MoUs, and other institutional\-industry engagement activities.



**4\. Internship Coordination** 



* Coordinate internship opportunities for students with suitable organizations.
* Communicate internship requirements and opportunities to students and academic departments.
* Assist in collecting and maintaining internship\-related documents and records.
* Track student internship status, joining, completion, and feedback.
* Maintain an updated internship database and submit periodic reports to the concerned authority.



**5\. Student Coordination \& Support** 



* Guide students regarding placement registration, eligibility criteria, recruitment procedures, interview schedules, and required documentation.
* Maintain regular communication with students regarding placement and training activities.
* Assist students in preparing resumes/CVs and other placement\-related documents.
* Coordinate student participation in off\-campus and on\-campus recruitment activities.
* Address routine student queries related to training, internships, and placements and escalate matters where required.



**6\. MIS, Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate records of student profiles, placement status, internship details, recruiter information, and training activities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and event\-wise reports as required by the Management.
* Maintain placement and training MIS in Excel/Google Sheets or other institutional systems.
* Track placement targets, recruitment drives, student participation, selections, offers, internships, and joining status.
* Ensure proper documentation of all Training \& Placement activities.



**7\. Coordination with Academic Departments** 



* Work closely with Principals, HODs, faculty members, and academic coordinators to identify placement and training requirements.
* Coordinate department\-wise student data and placement eligibility information.
* Ensure participation of students from different departments in relevant training and placement initiatives.
* Support academic departments in improving student placement readiness.



**8\. Event \& Activity Management** 



* Assist in planning and executing placement drives, job fairs, career fairs, industry interactions, seminars, workshops, and recruitment events.
* Coordinate venue, seating, registration, student attendance, recruiter requirements, and other logistical arrangements.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination among recruiters, students, faculty members, and administrative teams.



**9\. External Visits \& Field Coordination** 



* Visit corporate offices, companies, training organizations, and industry partners as required.
* Assist in corporate meetings, business development activities, industry visits, and placement\-related institutional collaborations.
* Willingness to travel within and outside Kolkata/West Bengal for placement and corporate relations activities, as required.



**10\. Additional Responsibilities** 



* Support the Senior Training \& Placement Officer / Head of the Department in achieving institutional placement and training objectives.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management from time to time in connection with Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations, Student Development, or Institutional Activities.



**Eligibility \& Qualification** 




**Essential Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institution.
* Minimum
 **6\-7 years of relevant experience** 
 in Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations,



**Preferred Qualification** 



* Master's Degree in Management, HR, Business Administration, Education, or a relevant discipline.
* Prior experience in an educational institution, university, college, training organization will be preferred.



**Essential Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Good presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly
 **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Ability to maintain MIS, databases, reports, and official documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with students, faculty members, management, and corporate representatives.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for corporate meetings, recruitment drives, industry visits, and institutional activities.



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The ideal candidate should be:
 


* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Confident and professional in communication.
* Well\-organized and disciplined.
* Comfortable interacting with students, faculty, management, and corporate professionals.
* Capable of working independently as well as part of a team.
* Flexible to handle multiple responsibilities and institutional requirements.
* Willing to take initiative and build long\-term corporate relationships.



**Why Join KEI?** 



* Opportunity to work with a growing and diverse educational institution.
* Exposure to corporate recruiters, industry professionals, and leading organizations.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in Training \& Placement and Corporate Relations.
* Professional growth in the education and employability\-development sector.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to student career development and institutional placement initiatives.

title: Specialist / Senior Specialist - HR IT Application
description:
It's about Being What's next.
 **What's in it for you?**

 The Specialist/Senior Specialist in this position will be a part of Global Services HR team, which provides IT Service Management for HR global applications and delivers HR IT solutions for business driven and process related changes through projects and enhancements. And provide functional consultancy and technical support on all global HR applications and integrations to other global and regional local systems, with primary focus on global SAP HR “SAPHRON”, SAPHRON Identity Management database “SAPFIM”, HR Middleware servers and the HR Linux servers. Support SOX compliance requirements and help ensure the integrity, security, and reliability of global HR applications, integrations, and employee data.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  


 Making an impact.
 **What will you do?**

* You will be directly partnering with global stakeholders and consumers of the SAPFIM database for modifications and integration enhancements, working independently to design and meet their needs
* Also, will share technical responsibility for the HR Middleware servers that manage global HR integrations
* Will be responsible for the technical support of HR Linux servers in the Azure datacentre for key add\-on modules of SAPHRON, namely Nakisa and Quick Document Builder (AQDB), aligning with Cloud Infrastructure Services team for lifecycle maintenance and third\-party vendors for upgrades
* And create and maintain integration files for TLC (top\-level comparison) between SAPHRON and the North America payroll systems, UltiPro
* Work on Troubleshooting, developing, and implementing resolutions to technical issues across the global HR landscape
* Also, working closely with the technical teams, manage day to day incidents logged in SMAX Incident Management tool
* Provide back up support for SAPHRON Externals Management functionality and process
* You will also support SOX controls, audit activities, and compliance requirements related to HR applications, integrations, and employee data



 Winning in your role.
 **Do you have what it takes?**

* You must have more than five (5\+) years professional work experience in service delivery and customer management and/or customer services and delivering customer application development solutions for clients
* And a university degree in computer systems design or computer science or comparable work experience
* Also, experience with SAP and systems integrations preferred
* And experience with SQL programming and database management
* You must possess IT process knowledge with focus on incident \& change management
* And practical experience with automated software and system management tools
* Very good command of English, spoken and written is a must



**Why you will love working for us!**

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
   

  

 Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: HR – Recruitment & HR Operations
description:

 Taksheela is a premier education consultancy focused on securing affordable global education for students worldwide. With expertise in career design and profile building, Taksheela fosters holistic education that aligns with the goals of NEP 2020\. The company is committed to making India a global education hub by championing the concept of "Internationalization at Home." For more information, visit www.taksheela.com.

**Why Join Taksheela?** 





 Exposure to Global Education Trends: Gain valuable insights into international education systems and emerging trends in the study abroad industry.
 





 Contribution to Shaping Education in India: Participate in projects aligned with the goals of NEP 2020\.
 





 Understanding "Internationalization at Home": Explore how India can become a global education hub and contribute to this initiative.
 





 Mentorship from Experienced Professionals: Receive guidance and support from experienced industry professionals.
 





 Networking Opportunities: Connect with professionals in education consultancy, universities, and international partners.
 




  





**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Salary:** 
 Up to ₹25,000 per month
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday
 



**Working Hours:** 
 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for a study\-abroad education consultancy.
* Source, screen, shortlist, and interview candidates for various roles.
* Handle recruitment for counsellors, telecallers , visa consultants, content, digital marketing, and other support roles.
* Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Prepare and post job descriptions on relevant recruitment platforms.
* Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
* Coordinate onboarding and joining formalities for selected candidates.
* Manage attendance, leave, employee records, and other HR documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day HR operations and employee communication.
* Coordinate with management and department heads regarding manpower requirements and recruitment needs.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3–5 years of relevant HR/recruitment experience.
* Strong experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and hiring requirements simultaneously.
* Prior experience in an education consultancy or study\-abroad company will be an advantage.

title: City Director, Kolkata
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The City Director (CD) plays a critical role in unleashing the potential and power of a local movement for educational equity in this metropolis. This individual creates and shapes a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context and develops a long\-term strategy that will fully realise the regional vision. The City Director, therefore, has a five\-fold charge:
 


1. Ensuring that Teach For India Fellows are not only driving transformational outcomes for children in classrooms, but that they’re growing as leaders.
2. Fostering a local, growing Alumni movement that is committed to providing all children an excellent education.
3. Building a local, enduring institution that promotes sustainable funding, talent, and operations – including assembling effective teams and resources, coaching talent to outcomes and leading the site rooted in strong culture
4. Serving as a critical organisational leader for operations that span Teach For India’s vision and mission.
5. Co\-creating the strategy \& roadmap to serve 1 in 10 children from low income communities in the city.



 To achieve that five\-fold charge, the CD works closely with the local program team to create an ecosystem of support for Fellows that enables them to be successful in their roles as teachers and future leaders of the movement. The CD also works to foster a sense of community among Alumni in the city and mobilises them towards shared goals, while also building partnerships with a range of government, corporate, and civil society players to catalyse systemic impact and ensure the long\-term sustainability of our efforts. Last but not least, the CD plays an integral role in building the capability and commitment of members of the City Operations team to contribute to our mission in the long\-term.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Envision, develop and update a contextualized vision for Teach For India’s operations in the city:** 



* Articulate a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context, yet directly aligned to Teach For India's larger national movement
* Phase out the city vision into a short\-mid\-and long term roadmap, with clearly defined goals and measures for success
* Build investment and ownership among Staff, Fellows, Alumni, \& Partners in the vision and goals.



**2\. Develop a strategic and operational plan that is designed to realise the vision:** 



* Design a strategic plan that effectively sets priorities, searches for innovative paths and best practices, and accounts for regional uncertainties and externalities.
* Design short\-term tactical plans to mobilise resources and guide a team to outcomes in the short\-and\-mid term



**3\. Manage the Executive Team in the city:** 



* Establish and/or strengthen infrastructure needed to maximize performance and operations of both talent and resources (processes, structure, systems, communication)
* Select, mentor and develop a group of your direct reports (managees) that is composed of the right skills, knowledge, and mindsets needed to advance transformational progress for children through the City roadmap.
* Build a systematic approach to people development to ensure that team members across the site are growing, performing and flourishing
* Establish clear accountability, decision making responsibilities, and performance expectations that are aligned to the strategic plan



**4\. Build relationships with key partners and stakeholders to foster collective impact and ensure long\-term sustainability:** 



* Build the site into a sustainable organisation rooted in local funding and talent
* Develop the operational infrastructure to enable scale and efficiency
* Engage with local networks, Alumni, education sector stakeholders to make Teach For India a strong voice in regional communities of practice
* Build, engage and strengthen a strong advisory board
* Play a front\-facing role in local fundraising efforts and capacities



**5\. Manage a growing team towards short\-term outcomes and long\-term success:** 



* Manage city vertical leads that span Program, Partnerships (Alumni \& Government) and People (Recruitment, HR, Job Placements, etc.)
* Design systems and processes to manage progress and people across layers
* Build and execute a strong performance management plan to ensure progress



**6\. Establish and uphold a strong culture of inspiration, honesty, support, and accountability among team members:** 



* Foster an internal team culture that is rooted in our organisational values.
* Model culture both internally and externally.
* Build on\-going relationships with our internal community



**7\. Collaborate with teams across clusters at Teach For India (People, Impact \& Operations, Movement Building, Regions, Office of the Senior Leadership team).** 




  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




**As a member of the Leadership team:** 



* Providing feedback on organisational decision\-making and long\-term strategy as a member of the Leadership Team.
* Driving internal alignment and support for Teach For India’s core Programs.
* Serving as an ambassador of the Teach For India brand and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication.
* Supporting key organisational areas such as Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Movement Building, and Alumni Engagement.
* Over time, supporting Teach For India’s Alumni and other external organisations in their journey to our vision with organisational insights.



  





**Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations** 



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in any field with 8\+ years of relevant work experience
* Previous experience managing large projects and teams to successful outcomes
* Previous teaching/education experience would be an added advantage
* Strategic and critical thinking skills so as to conceptualise multiple approaches to solving a problem and draw out a clear roadmap with roles and responsibilities
* Relationship\-building and networking skills so as to connect individuals, groups, and partners with shared goals
* Influencing and persuasion skills so as to leverage people and relationships to outcomes
* Communication skills so as to deliver a compelling message through oral and written mediums to diverse stakeholders
* People management skills so as to manage diverse teams to outcomes
* Ability to be resourceful and entrepreneurial in the face of uncertainty
* Proficiency in analysing data and making inferences to drive strategies and decisions
* Understanding of Teach For India’s short\-term and long\-term theory of change
* Understanding of Teach For India’s leadership development philosophy and framework

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll build and run our whole People \& Culture function — starting from almost nothing — and turn People into one of the company's real strengths. This is a hands\-on leadership job: senior enough to design the system, close enough to still hire a key person yourself. You'll report to the CEO and own the result, not a task list.
 



  





**What you'll own, end to end:** 



* **Hiring** 
 — build the pipeline, the process, and our name as an employer, so the founders don't have to find people themselves.
* **HR Operations \& Compliance** 
 — keep our HR system clean and current, handle payroll inputs and legal compliance (PF, ESI, POSH), and give every new hire a smooth start.
* **Performance** 
 — set clear goals, run the review cycle, and work with the founders to help every person do their best.
* **Culture \& Engagement** 
 — bring our values to life, keep a pulse on how people feel, and keep attrition low.
* **Learning \& AI** 
 — set up onboarding, run regular training, and get the team using AI in daily work.
* **People \& Team** 
 — plan ahead for hiring, advise the CEO, and build and lead a small People team of 3–5 that grows with the company.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 20\+ roles closed this year, all top\-quality hires
* HR system clean and current, every offer letter out within 48 hours
* Every employee working to clear quarterly goals, with the first full review cycle done on time
* First engagement survey run with 80%\+ taking part, and attrition held at 15% or below
* Proper onboarding for every hire, AI used across the company, and a quarterly training calendar delivered



  





**Must Have** 



* **You've led and scaled** 
**8–12 years in HR** 
 , with at least 2\-3 years leading a team and helped grow a company's headcount.
* **A hiring track record you can prove** 
 — specific people you've hired, with titles and dates, including a senior role you closed yourself.
* **You've built, not maintained** 
 — set up an HR function from scratch.
* **All\-round HR judgment** 
 — operations, compliance, performance, and culture, not just one part.
* **You know your numbers** 
 — time\-to\-fill, offer acceptance, and attrition, off the top of your head.
* **You're in Kolkata** 
 , or can move here within 30 days.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Structured hiring methods — scorecards and proper reference checks
* Experience running a company on a system like Scaling Up, EOS, or OKRs
* Business sense — you read the commercial side, not just the people side
* AI in your work today — you can show a real way you use it, not just talk about it



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
